title: Territory Manager
description:
**ABOUT SOLENIS**  

Solenis is a leading global producer of specialty chemicals focused on partnering with water\-intensive operations to solve complex water treatment, process improvement and hygiene challenges with advanced chemical and equipment solutions for consumer, industrial, institutional, food \& beverage, and recreational pool and spa water markets.

  

The product portfolio of Solenis includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, and cleaners and disinfectants, as well as state\-of\-the\-art monitoring and control systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments.

  

Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, the company has 69 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over 16,100 professionals in 130 countries across six continents. Solenis has been recognized as a Best Managed Company for 4 consecutive years and was named as 2024 Best Managed Company Gold Standard Winner.

 **POSITION PURPOSE:**


The Territory Manager will be primarily responsible for Business Development and Key Account Management in the Building Care Domain**,** primarily focusing on Diversey’s Floor Care and Equipment Portfolio. The target customer segment for this business will ideally be all large Building Service Contractors, Offices, Retail, and other Infrastructure Facilities.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Continuously focus on sales growth execution and sales target achievement through new account research and acquisition planning, leveraging sector expertise and market intelligence.
* Take the lead initiative in developing rapport with identified key Accounts in the assigned territory.
* Gain business at targeted new accounts within pricing/margin guidelines.
* Continually evaluate key competitor activities, analyse effectiveness and prepare defensive strategic ploys.
* Develop business relationship with key decision makers to further our business interests.
* Implement with the team customer training \& education training programs.
* Manage effective internal stakeholders (Customer Service, Marketing \& Finance) relationships and ability to deliver the Building Care strategy through matrix reporting structure.
* Work closely with Application Specialists to identify and develop relevant value propositions for customers.

  

Sales Reporting

* Plan daily, weekly and annual objectives and activities to maximise customer contact and effectiveness.
* Continuously update all sales activities (e.g., funnel) using Salesforce or other CRM systems.
* Provide a monthly update to direct manager on the following:
	+ Tracking against KPI’s
	+ Plans for the coming month/quarter
	+ Performance against previous plans

  



**KNOWLEDGE/EXPERIENCE/PERSON** **PROFILE**

* 2\+ Years of overall Experience in Sales Management in B2B Business profiles from Chemicals, Building Materials, Infrastructure, BSC domain.
* Strong expertise in Distribution Channel Management and Account Management
* Deep understanding of Sales and Distribution with a high level of strategic planning and analytical skills

title: Manager, Solution Consulting Operations
description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.  

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
Overview:

We are looking for an Operations Manager \- Revenue and Solution Engineering to support our global GTM teams by delivering rapid, quality support to the global Solution Engineering, RevOps and Enablement teams. This role reports to the Senior Director of Services, with dotted\-lines to the Demo Engineering, RevOps and Revenue Enablement leaders, based in the US.
Who you are::
* 2\-5\+ years of leading high performing teams, ideally supporting sales functions
* 3\+ years working with SaaS products and technologies
* Demonstrated ability to work cross functionally
* Familiarity with SaaS businesses, metrics, goals, challenges
* Knowledge of technology in the sales tech, CRM or martech space
* Knowledge of how businesses and sales teams operate in our target market
* Proven strong executive leadership and decision making abilities
* Strong communication skills, ability to articulate and sell a vision internally and externally
* Strong execution skills and the ability to drive action and accountability
* Proven track record of hiring, developing and managing world\-class talent
* Experience working with and/or deploying Sales/Marketing/Service technologies.
* Working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce.com, Dynamics 365\).
* Entrepreneurial spirit and mindset, a focus on possibilities and not obstacle
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and change
* Proven track record of defining and optimizing processes
* Strong written and spoken English


What you'll be doing::
* Lead and oversee a team of Revenue Enablement, Revenue Operations and Demo Engineering


practitioners for daily local management.* Support the global Solution Engineering teams to deliver and maintain our standard and custom demo capability.
* Work with the global Enablement \& Operations team to establish the strategy, plan, and prioritization for process and tool enablement for internal teams, including both JIT and formal training strategies.
* Lead and oversee a small team of Revenue Operations system administrators supporting Salesforce and the broader GTM technology stack.
* Scale Organizations, Processes and Operations. Work with global leaders to design, refine and innovate the service and processes as our company grows and evolves.
* Report on key metrics to indicate the success of global programmes.
* Develop a High Performing, High Engagement Team and Culture. Coach and develop your direct reports. Demonstrate very high emotional intelligence. Set and uphold the highest performance standards. Help colleagues “enjoy the ride” \- one of our core guiding principles.
* Partner effectively across functions. Act as an ally and partner to colleagues in sister functions \- Product, Account Management, Marketing and others \- making decisions that take broader perspectives into account and providing insight into others’ decisions. Demonstrate a balanced, reasoned approach to conflict or differing priorities.
* Cultivate deep product knowledge. Gain deep knowledge, understanding, and experience with the Highspot platform and the value it provides businesses.


Job Posting Footer:  

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.  

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

title: Service Manager/Apps Manager
description:
Job Summary
  
Drive end to end service management for complex application portfolios by applying deep experience in ITSM process governance and ITIL practices. Ensure stable and efficient service delivery in a hybrid work model while partnering with business stakeholders in sales and marketing to align application services with strategic outcomes and enhance user satisfaction across the organization.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Lead the overall governance of IT service management processes to ensure consistent application of ITSM standards and reliable delivery of services across multiple business functions including sales and marketing.
  
Oversee incident problem and change management activities for applications to achieve high service availability and swift resolution of disruptions while minimizing impact to business operations.
  
Provide structured guidance to operations and application teams in applying ITIL practices so that workflows are streamlined risks are controlled and service performance is continuously improved.
  
Coordinate day to day service reviews with stakeholders to track service levels identify trends and prioritize actions that enhance stability and user experience for business critical applications.
  
Monitor key performance indicators related to ITSM processes and prepare concise reports that highlight service health emerging issues and recommended corrective actions for management visibility.
  
Collaborate closely with product owners and business teams in sales and marketing to align application service capabilities with ongoing campaigns customer engagement objectives and revenue goals.
  
Ensure that service catalogs configuration records and support documentation are maintained accurately so that teams can resolve issues efficiently and new colleagues can onboard smoothly.
  
Drive root cause analysis for recurring issues and coordinate implementation of preventive measures that strengthen application resilience and reduce future incidents.
  
Manage vendor and partner interactions related to application support to ensure adherence to agreed service levels timely escalation handling and clear communication of expectations.
  
Support continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing service data proposing pragmatic process enhancements and validating that changes deliver measurable benefits.
  
Coordinate service transition activities for new or updated applications so that support readiness operational acceptance and risk considerations are addressed before go live.
  
Advise business stakeholders on service implications of planned changes helping them schedule activities during day shifts that balance operational needs and minimize disruption.
  
Promote a culture of accountability and collaboration within service teams by setting clear expectations for process compliance responsiveness and focus on business outcomes.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Apply extensive experience in ITSM process governance to design and refine policies that keep services reliable compliant and aligned with organizational standards.
  
Use advanced knowledge of ITIL V4 and related ITIL practices to translate framework concepts into practical procedures that fit complex enterprise environments.
  
Leverage at least ten years of work in application or service management to handle ambiguity coordinate multiple stakeholders and manage priorities effectively in a hybrid work setting.
  
Demonstrate strong analytical and communication skills to interpret service metrics explain technical issues in business language and gain consensus on improvement plans.
  
Utilize familiarity with sales and marketing domains to understand campaign timelines sales processes and customer engagement drivers so that application services support these goals effectively.
  
Employ solid experience working within structured day shift operations to coordinate handoffs maintain timely responses and optimize collaboration across distributed teams.
  
Exhibit proficiency in using service management tools for incident tracking change coordination and reporting to maintain transparency and traceability of service activities.

title: Sales & Marketing Operations Executive
description:
**Sales \& Marketing Operations Executive**
===========================================


**Address:** Somajiguda, Hyd


**Role Purpose**
----------------


To manage the backend engine of sales and marketing by ensuring enquiry tracking, quotation preparation, customer follow\-ups, documentation, coordination with internal departments, agency coordination, order\-status communication, and customer experience follow\-through.


This is not a hardcore marketing strategy role. This is an execution, coordination, follow\-up, CRM, and documentation role.


**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


* **Experience:** 2–5 years
* **Qualification:** Graduate
* **Background:** Sales coordination, customer support, back\-office sales, CRM, order processing, commercial coordination, or operations support
* **Skills:** Excellent follow\-up, Excel/CRM discipline, email writing, coordination, documentation, and ownership
* **Age:** Flexible. Do not restrict unnecessarily to 28–35 unless there is a strong reason.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **A. Enquiry \& Lead Coordination**


* Maintain a live enquiry tracker with source, customer name, requirement, status, next follow\-up date, quotation status, expected order value, and responsible sales person.
* Send brochures, data sheets, company profiles, product details, catalogues, and introductory emailers to prospects as per approved templates.
* Maintain a proper follow\-up sequence for every enquiry so that no lead is forgotten.
* Coordinate with the sales team to understand whether the enquiry is hot, warm, cold, closed, lost, or needs senior intervention.

### **B. Quotation \& Sales Documentation**


* Prepare and send quotations based on approved pricing, formats, terms, and inputs from the sales/commercial team.
* Prepare proforma invoices wherever required.
* Check customer purchase orders against company sales policy, approved price, delivery terms, payment terms, taxes, freight, and other commercial conditions.
* Escalate any mismatch in PO terms to the senior sales/commercial team before order processing.
* Maintain records of quotations sent, revised quotes, approvals, purchase orders, proforma invoices, and order confirmations.

### **C. Customer Follow\-Up / Keeping in Touch (KIT) System**


* Follow up with customers for pending quotations, expected order confirmation, advance payment, dispatch clearance, inspection dates, and documentation.
* Use a defined KIT strategy , Keep In Touch sequence , for structured customer communication.
* Send polite reminder emails, WhatsApp messages, and call follow\-ups as per approved scripts.
* Escalate delayed or high\-value follow\-ups to the relevant salesperson or senior manager.
* Ensure customers receive timely updates without depending only on sales representatives.

### **D. Sales Backend \& Commercial Coordination**


* Coordinate with sales representatives for customer updates, pending documents, order status, and follow\-up remarks.
* Coordinate with the commercial department for order processing, production plan review, dispatch clearance, invoices, and payment documents.
* Coordinate with the factory/production team for material readiness, inspection status, dispatch planning, and expected timelines.
* Coordinate with transporters for vehicle placement, LR details, dispatch acknowledgements, and delivery confirmation.
* Generate or coordinate sale invoices where applicable.

### **E. Customer Experience \& Completion Documentation**


* Send order completion reports to customers after supply.
* Obtain completion certificates from customers for company records.
* Track customer complaints, delays, missing documents, delayed dispatches, and unresolved issues.
* Maintain a customer experience tracker showing whether the customer had a smooth, delayed, problematic, or escalated experience.
* Share recurring customer issues with management for process improvement.

### **F. Agency \& Marketing Collateral Coordination**


* Coordinate with marketing agencies/freelancers for brochures, datasheets, catalogues, emailers, LinkedIn creatives, and other collaterals.
* Collect inputs from sales/product/management and convert them into clear agency briefs.
* Maintain updated folders of final approved marketing material.
* Ensure the sales team has access to the latest brochures, presentations, company profile, product sheets, and email templates.
* Track agency deliverables, deadlines, approvals, and revisions.

### **G. Records, CRM \& MIS**


* Maintain customer\-wise files containing enquiry history, quotations, PO, PI, correspondence, dispatch details, invoices, payment status, completion certificate, and complaints.
* Update CRM/Excel/ERP daily.
* Prepare weekly MIS on enquiries, quotes sent, follow\-ups due, orders received, pending advances, dispatches, completion certificates pending, and payments pending.
* Share ageing reports for pending quotations, pending customer approvals, pending payments, and pending documents.
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------


* Number of enquiries entered and tracked weekly


* Number of quotations prepared and sent


* Quotation\-to\-order follow\-up completion rate


* Number of overdue follow\-ups


* Average quotation turnaround time


* Number of completion certificates collected


* Pending payment follow\-up ageing


* Number of customer documents pending


* Agency deliverables completed on time


* CRM/Excel/ERP update accuracy percentage


**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) \& Measurement**
--------------------------------------------------


### **Enquiry tracking discipline**


**Measurement:** 100% of enquiries entered within 24 hours


### **Quotation turnaround**


**Measurement:** Standard quotes sent within agreed TAT


### **Follow\-up discipline**


**Measurement:** No follow\-up overdue beyond 48 hours


### **Documentation accuracy**


**Measurement:** PO/PI/quotation errors below defined tolerance

title: Email Marketing and Campaign Manager
description:
**Role Overview**


Cambridge Technology is seeking an experienced Email Marketing \& Campaign Manager to plan, manage, and execute email campaigns across all Cambridge brands, products, and target audiences. This contractor will own the complete campaign lifecycle from campaign strategy, audience selection, and scheduling through automation, deployment, optimization, and performance reporting.


The role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking and hands\-on campaign management. The selected candidate will work with internal marketing, content, design, product, sales, and technology teams to deliver relevant, timely, and compliant email communications that strengthen engagement, support lead generation, and contribute to business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage the email marketing strategy and campaign calendar across all Cambridge brands, products, and business priorities.
* Manage end\-to\-end execution of newsletters, product promotions, lead\-nurturing programs, event campaigns, cold\-outreach campaigns, customer communications, and re\-engagement campaigns.
* Define campaign objectives, target audiences, segmentation criteria, messaging requirements, schedules, workflows, and calls to action.
* Build, configure, test, schedule, and deploy email campaigns using relevant email marketing and marketing automation platforms.
* Create automated workflows, nurture sequences, drip campaigns, lead\-scoring logic, triggers, and lifecycle\-based communication programs.
* Manage contact segmentation, suppression lists, subscription preferences, consent records, data quality, duplicate records, and campaign eligibility rules.
* Conduct A/B and multivariate testing across subject lines, sender names, content, calls to action, layouts, timing, and audience segments.
* Monitor campaign performance, analyze results, identify improvement opportunities, and provide clear recommendations and reports to internal stakeholders.
* Manage email deliverability by monitoring sender reputation, bounce rates, spam complaints, domain authentication, inbox placement, and engagement quality.
* Ensure campaigns comply with applicable email marketing and data privacy requirements, including CAN\-SPAM, GDPR, consent management, and unsubscribe regulations.
* Maintain campaign documentation, naming conventions, templates, quality\-control checklists, approval processes, and reporting standards.
* Stay current with changes in email marketing technology, automation practices, privacy regulations, deliverability standards, and AI\-enabled campaign optimization.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of hands\-on experience in email marketing, campaign management, marketing automation, or a related digital marketing role.
* Demonstrated experience managing the complete lifecycle of B2B email campaigns across multiple brands, products, audiences, or markets.
* Strong knowledge of campaign planning, audience segmentation, personalization, marketing automation, lead nurturing, and customer lifecycle communications.
* Hands\-on experience building, testing, deploying, and optimizing campaigns using leading email marketing and automation platforms.
* Strong understanding of email deliverability, sender reputation, bounce management, spam prevention, domain authentication, and inbox\-placement practices.
* Working knowledge of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, subscription management, consent requirements, and applicable email marketing regulations.
* Experience with A/B testing, campaign analytics, attribution, reporting, and translating performance data into actionable recommendations.

title: SEO Executive
description:
We are looking for a results\-driven **SEO Executive** to improve our website’s organic search visibility, rankings, traffic, and overall search performance. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with on\-page and off\-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO, and SEO analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct keyword research and identify relevant search opportunities.
* Optimize website content, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking.
* Perform technical SEO audits and identify issues affecting crawlability, indexing, page speed, and website performance.
* Develop and execute on\-page and off\-page SEO strategies.
* Build and manage high\-quality backlinks through ethical link\-building techniques.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and other SEO KPIs.
* Analyze competitors and identify opportunities to improve search visibility.
* Create SEO recommendations for website content, landing pages, blogs, and product/service pages.
* Use tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Keyword Planner, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.
* Track algorithm updates and implement SEO best practices accordingly.
* Prepare regular SEO performance reports and provide actionable insights.
* Collaborate with content writers, developers, designers, and digital marketing teams to implement SEO improvements.

**General Responsibilities** 

* Plan and execute SEO strategies to improve website visibility and organic traffic.
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Optimize website content, meta tags, headings, URLs, and internal links.
* Perform regular SEO audits and identify areas for improvement.
* Build and maintain quality backlinks through ethical link\-building practices.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, and website performance.
* Manage and optimize Google Search Console and Google Analytics data.
* Coordinate with content, development, and marketing teams for SEO implementation.
* Identify and fix basic technical SEO issues.
* Stay updated with search engine algorithm changes and SEO trends.
* Prepare weekly/monthly SEO performance reports.
* Support content creation and ensure content follows SEO best practices.
* Track SEO KPIs and suggest improvements based on performance data.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of On\-Page, Off\-Page, and Technical SEO
* Hands\-on experience with Keyword Research and Competitor Analysis
* Proficiency in Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)
* Experience with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, or similar
* Knowledge of Google Keyword Planner
* Understanding of Technical SEO, crawling, indexing, redirects, canonical tags, and XML sitemaps
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and website structure
* Understanding of Meta Titles, Meta Descriptions, Header Tags, Alt Tags, and Internal Linking
* Knowledge of Link Building and Backlink Analysis
* Familiarity with Core Web Vitals and website page\-speed optimization
* Understanding of SEO\-friendly content optimization

* Ability to analyze SEO data and prepare performance reports and insights
